On behalf of the board of directors (the “Board”), I am delighted to report          本人謹代表董事會（「董事會」），欣然向各位股

subsidiaries (the “Group”) for the financial year ended 31 December 2022 (the        團」）截至二零二二年十二月三十一日止財政年

the Russia-Ukraine war and other geopolitical clashes, sporadic COVID-19             緣政治衝突包括俄烏戰爭、國內疫情反覆尤其

on most industries. Faced with these complex market challenges, despite              擊，縱使面對複雜的市場挑戰，憑藉集團垂直

strengthen its competitive advantage built on a vertical value chain and             的競爭優勢，以及有賴建滔同仁努力不懈，
diversified business portfolio, enabling it to deliver an underlying net profit of   在市況疲弱及成本高企下集團仍能收穫超過
over HK$3.8 billion.                                                                 三十八億港元的基本純利。

           exclude cash and cash equivalents, deferred tax assets, and                      評估下之總資產不包括現金及現

           needed.                                                                          活動及資產被釐定為並非業務及

           Asset acquisitions                                                               資產收購

            profit or loss.                                                                     公平值計入損益之金融資產及金

                                                                                                會即時於損益確認。

            The effective interest method is a method of calculating                           實際利率法是一種計算金融資產
            the amortised cost of a financial asset or financial liability                     或金融負債攤銷成本與相關期間
            and of allocating interest income and interest expense over                        分派利息收入及利息支出之方
            the relevant period. The effective interest rate is the rate                       法。實際利率是於金融資產或金
            that exactly discounts estimated future cash receipts and                          融負債的估計可使用年期或（如
            payments (including all fees and points paid or received that                      適用）更短期間將估計未來現金
            form an integral part of the effective interest rate, transaction                  收入及付款（包括所有已付或已
            costs and other premiums or discounts) through the expected                        收並構成實際利率一部分之費
            life of the financial asset or financial liability, or, where                      用、交易成本及其他溢價或折
            appropriate, a shorter period, to the net carrying amount on                       價）精確折現至初步確認時之賬
            initial recognition.                                                               面淨值之比率。

      consolidated financial statements. Hong Kong Profits Tax is calculated            個年度的香港利得稅按估計應課稅溢利
      at 16.5% of the estimated assessable profit for both years.                       的16.5%計算。

      In determining the fair value of the relevant properties, the Directors      為釐定相關物業的公平值，董事會已成
      have set up a valuation committee, which is headed up by the                 立估值委員會，由負責本集團財務事務
      persons in charge of financial matters of the Group, to determine            的人士帶領，以就公平值計量釐定適當
      the appropriate valuation techniques and inputs for fair value               的估值技術及輸入數據。
      measurements.

      The Group engages an independent qualified valuer to perform                 本集團委聘獨立合資格估值師估值。估
      its valuations. The valuation committee works closely with the               值委員會與獨立合資格估值師緊密合
      independent qualified valuer to establish the appropriate valuation          作，共同制定模型之適當估值技術及輸
      techniques and inputs to the model. The persons in charge of financial       入數據。財務事宜負責人每季向董事匯
      matters report the valuation committee’s findings to the Directors           報估值委員會之發現，闡明資產公平值
      every quarter to explain the cause of fluctuations in the fair value of      波動之因由。
      the assets.

      The Group’s investment properties were classified as Level 3 of the          本集團投資物業於二零二二年及二零
      fair value hierarchy as at 31 December 2022 and 2021.                        二一年十二月三十一日分類為第三級公
                                                                                   平值架構級別。

      Advisory Limited is a member of the Hong Kong Institute of Surveyors.        準達致。瑞豐環球評估諮詢有限公司為
      The valuation was determined based on direct comparison method               香港測量師學會會員。估值乃參考類似

      in consideration of timing of reference transactions, and property-          間及物業特定調整因素，以直接比較法
